# Step - json_path

`json_path` · category: [Values and properties](../../traversal/step_reference.md#values-and-properties)

Reads a nested value from each element with a JSONPath (Graphersal extension, see the book page Path keys (jpath)).

## Forms

```text
json_path(arg1: string)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject(#{a: #{b: [1, 2]}}).json_path("a.b[1]").next()   // 2
```
